name: typedesc-tests-6cfb08048c/typedesc-v.bal
spec_references: Subset restrictions > Import declarations: "Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported"; ballerina/lang.value lists "cloneWithType", "fromJsonWithType", "toString", "toBalString".

Subset restrictions > Invocations > Other invocation restrictions: "Method call syntax can be used for calling the following langlib functions:" includes "value:cloneWithType", "value:fromJsonWithType", and "value:toString and value:toBalString", but not isReadOnly.
Supported language features (subset 10) > Expressions: lists "Type test expression", "Type cast expression", "List constructor" and "Mapping constructor"; does not list typeof or table constructors.
reason: The whole case requires unsupported lang.value isReadOnly() calls in executed intersection-type conversion assertions. Although cloneWithType, fromJsonWithType and toString are explicitly supported, isReadOnly is absent from both the exhaustive langlib allowlist and method-syntax allowlist. This decisive restriction makes the case a feature request. It also exercises typeof expressions and a table constructor, neither covered by the positive expression list.
unsupported_constructs: isReadOnly() langlib method calls on converted arrays and tables
typeof expressions (not covered by the expression list)
table constructor expression (not covered by the expression list)
test_design_notes: Mixed scope: basic typedesc declarations/casts, supported conversions and stringification are combined with unsupported readonly inspection and uncovered expressions.
Several tuple/json conversion checks initialize t1 and j1 with arr.cloneWithType(a), reusing the int-array descriptor instead of t and j; these checks do not test the intended target descriptors.
@output markers assert typedesc rendering and type tests; io:println is instrumentation. No @args or @panic markers appear.
